onb.welcome.title: Welcome to DodoTopia
onb.welcome.intro: DodoTopia plays music, draws and cooks for you in Heartopia. A few quick steps to get started.
onb.welcome.lang_help: Languages marked beta may still show some French text.
onb.game.title: Heartopia
onb.game.intro: DodoTopia sends keys to the game window. Here is what it sees right now.
onb.game.found_help: The game is open: you can move on.
onb.game.missing_help: The game is not open yet. You can go on: DodoTopia will detect it as soon as it starts.
onb.game.elevated: Heartopia runs as administrator: restart DodoTopia as administrator
onb.game.unchecked_help: No game process name is set (Settings › Music and audio › Advanced). Everything still works.
onb.game.tip: Tip: keep the Heartopia window in front while DodoTopia plays, draws or cooks.
onb.song.title: First song
onb.song.intro: Add a song, pick the instrument you hold in the game, then check that a note gets through.
onb.song.test_hint: After clicking, switch back to Heartopia before the delay ends ({delay} s): DodoTopia will send one key of your instrument.
game.admin.title: Heartopia runs as administrator
game.admin.body: To play, draw or cook: close DodoTopia, then right-click its icon and choose “Run as administrator”.
game.admin.why: Windows prevents a normally started program from sending keys to a game running as administrator.
game.notice.admin: Heartopia runs as administrator: DodoTopia must too, or keys will not reach the game.
game.test.title: Sends one note of your instrument to the game after the start delay
game.test.go_back: Switch back to Heartopia: the note goes out in {delay} s
deeplink.intro: A dodotopia:// link asks DodoTopia to do this. Nothing happens without your approval.
onb.discord.title: Join the other players
onb.discord.intro: Sign in with Discord to enjoy everything that happens together. It's free and takes a few seconds.
onb.discord.unavailable: The server is not responding right now: you can sign in later from the button at the top right.
onb.discord.optional: Optional: you can skip this step and sign in later from the button at the top right.
